title: BloodZone
description: Real-time blood donor matching app with geospatial search, push notifications, JWT auth, and Socket.io chat. Built with React Native, Express, and MongoDB.

title: Kantoo
description: A Kanban board built with React and TypeScript. Supports drag and drop for tasks and columns, persists state across sessions, and optimizes renders using React.memo and useCallback for noticeably smoother interactions.

title: Kuan
description: A lightweight HTTP/1.1 server built from scratch in C using POSIX sockets and a custom thread-pool architecture. No frameworks, no libraries. Just raw sockets.
